_doc: Quillmarch, the post-game Era III region (scripts/core/Region3.gd, tests/unit/test_region3.gd). Opens with the flag in unlock_flag after the Era II finale (Vellmarch chapter 5, data/eras.json finale_flags) and is drawn in Era III (rich palette, 64 px sprites, art/era3). Its colours are data/region_looks.json 'quillmarch', its tiles art/era3/tiles/overworld_quillmarch.png (tools/art/gen_tiles_quillmarch.py). Towns and routes carry grid cells for a later world_layout.json entry; maps are built from this sheet. Encounter slots name Quillmarch's own Era III Spirlings (tools/art/lines/quillmarch.py); every slot now holds an own kind (the Acid and Frost kinds came with the second batch); stand_in is kept for reference only. Wardens hold the four Rifts; every chapter of the arc has at least one betrayal. Acid and Frost are the region's elements (data/type_chart.json). Rings 70 to 88.
name: Quillmarch

arrival.text: The mail boat to Quillmarch carries letters, crates and you. Only you are not on the manifest.

towns.name: Burin Landing
towns.text: The pier is built from old printing plates. Every plank is somebody's confession, backwards.

towns.name: Platewick
towns.text: Engravers on every corner. Ask for a portrait and you get a wanted poster, signed.

towns.name: Mordant Row
towns.text: The acid baths steam all day. Locals have no eyebrows and very strong opinions.

towns.name: Rimeholt
towns.text: The frost etches the windows, the debts etch the people. Both go deeper every winter.

towns.name: Ledgerholm
towns.text: Bankers and forgers share one street and, on Sundays, one choir.

towns.name: Proofgate
towns.text: The last press house before the edge of the map. Nothing leaves without a stamp, least of all you.

wardens.name: Warden Mavet
wardens.intro: Breathe deep, it clears the sinuses. And the lungs. And eventually the estate.
wardens.defeat: Fine, the Rift is yours. The cure for the fumes is still mine, and the price just went up.

wardens.name: Warden Quenby
wardens.intro: The frost writes a warning on every window. I only read out the ones somebody paid for.
wardens.defeat: Your warning was on my window all week. Nobody paid, so I let you walk in.

wardens.name: Warden Ottoline
wardens.intro: Two ledgers, one truth, zero witnesses. Pick a book, darling. Any book.
wardens.defeat: You win. I would congratulate you, but the ledger says you were never here.

wardens.name: Warden Grisel
wardens.intro: I printed your ferry ticket, your fame and your fixer's new face. Let's see if I can print your loss.
wardens.defeat: Keep the press. The map is already printed, and every Rift on it has my name in the margin.

story.title: Chapter 1: The Fine Print
story.text: Wren Marlow waits on the pier with a new face and the same old grin. The print houses want the Rifts etched shut, and they pay in fresh money. Very fresh. Still wet.

betrayal.text: The money is forged, the job is real, and Wren sold your arrival time to the Gravers' Guild before your boat had docked.

story.title: Chapter 2: Bitten Copper
story.text: The acid baths eat through their vats and into the street. Warden Mavet keeps the Bath Rift and bottles the fumes as medicine.

betrayal.text: Mavet poured the acid into the town well herself, then sold the town the cure, then sold you the town.

story.title: Chapter 3: Cold Hands
story.text: Frost etches warnings onto every window in Rimeholt. The Gravers' Guild hires you to thaw the Rime Rift before the town freezes over.

betrayal.text: The Guild holds the debts of every house in Rimeholt. Frozen houses sell cheap, and you were hired to be slow.

story.title: Chapter 4: Two Sets of Books
story.text: Ledgerholm keeps two ledgers: one for the bank and one for the truth. Ottoline wants you to burn one of them. She will not say which.

betrayal.text: Ottoline swapped the books. The one you burned was the only record that you are not the forger.

story.title: Chapter 5: Last Proof
story.text: Under Proofgate the great press still runs, printing a new map of the world with every Rift drawn in as property. Grisel stamps the last page.

betrayal.text: Grisel paid for your boat, your fame and Wren's new face. Every Rift you sealed raised the price of the ones he owns.
